newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-RODMAN SUSPENDED ONE GAME, FINED $7,500.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-RODMAN SUSPENDED ONE GAME, FINED $7,500.

text.p: Chicago Bulls bad boy Dennis Rodman is in trouble again for hitting someone in the groin.

Rodman was suspended for one game without pay and fined $7,500 by the National Basketball Association Tuesday for deliberately striking Milwaukee's Joe Wolf in the groin during Monday night's 108-90 victory over the Bucks.
The incident occurred when the two scuffled late in the third quarter.
Earlier this season, Rodman was suspended 11 games and fined $25,000 for kicking a cameraman in the groin during a January 15 game at Minnesota.
Rodman will miss Wednesday's home game against his former team, the San Antonio Spurs.
His earlier 11-game suspension cost him $1.1 million in salary and incentives.

The latest suspension is the third of the season for Chicago's rebounding machine, who was banned two games by the Bulls for a profanity-laced tirade at referees after a December 8 loss at Toronto. That cost him more than $200,000.
